    Using this offline
    1. Open this link once with signal and wait until this section starts with "Saved on this phone for offline use". It then works with no signal.
    2. Tap Start GPS and allow location, then use ⋮ → Add to Home screen in Chrome.
    3. Phone GPS works without signal. Turn on Location and set it to high accuracy. Airplane mode with location on saves battery.
    4. Tap Start walk when you get off the bus. Times then use your real pace, including stops.
    5. Stops are counted from GPS: staying in one spot for about a minute, or GPS pausing while you barely moved. Your stops replace the setting in Settings over the first hour of walking.
    6. The page remembers your start time and track if the browser is closed. Save your track as GPX at the end if you want to keep it.
    7. The GPX route can also go into another app (OS Maps, Komoot, Gaia) as a backup.
    8. 3D: tap 3D on the map. Drag to turn, pinch to zoom, two fingers to move. Fly the route plays a tour.

    Times use Naismith's rule (your flat speed plus 1 hour per 600 m of climbing) plus 10 minutes per 300 m of steep descent. Gentle descents count as flat. Malham Cove is an unfenced 70 m cliff: stay well back from the edge. The limestone pavement has deep cracks and is very slippery when wet. The rocks at Janet's Foss and the Cove steps can be slick. Do not try the scramble up the waterfall at Gordale Scar. Carry OS Explorer OL2 (Yorkshire Dales, Southern & Western) and a compass. This page helps, but it is not a navigation device.

    Paths © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Heights from EU-DEM 25 m (Copernicus), summits corrected to their known heights. Times are estimates.
